scope: Compress bounded terminal observations without replacing owner-model code reading, editing, review, or judgment.

methods.name: semantic aggregation
methods.result: Eight operation classes expose bounded decision-relevant facts instead of raw logs.

methods.name: successful-default elision
methods.result: Fields implied by OK are omitted; failures retain exit and operation-health evidence.

methods.name: duplicate diagnostic removal
methods.result: Repeated normalized evidence lines appear once, preserving budget for distinct failures.

methods.name: workspace path normalization
methods.result: The current workspace prefix becomes a relative dot in bounded evidence.

methods.name: adaptive disclosure
methods.result: more=1 distinguishes valid partial evidence from a complete source or diff.

methods.name: batched observation
methods.result: Up to four operations share one wrapper startup and owner tool response.

exactOwnerTokenEvidence.note: This paired Sol ingestion experiment predates successful-default elision and is retained as the exact model-token measurement. New release deltas below are end-to-end bytes, not estimated tokens.

realProjects.method: Seven alternating end-to-end runs after warm-up; pytest, Git status, search, and file discovery are identical between plain and HelioTerm arms.

boundary: The local wrapper still adds a measured 27-29 ms median to these already hand-batched workloads. HelioTerm saves owner context and tool turns; it does not claim that a fresh Node process makes tiny commands intrinsically faster.
